name: Turbulence Function

Turbulence Function — Improved Perlin Noise, M-Noise, Modified Noise, Procedural Noise for Micro-level Details, Turbulence
definition: Use of procedural noise (M-Noise or Improved Perlin Noise) to create micro-level details and animation in the pixel shader, employing a turbulence function that sums different octaves of noise.
summary: The Turbulence Function generates fractal micro-details for volumetric effects by summing absolute noise octaves, distinguished by its GPU efficiency using M-Noise.
